messages:
priya: Hey folks — quick ask. Candidate (SWE2) scheduled Thu 3:00pm PT. Jordan just flagged they can’t make it (family thing). Can someone pick up the technical portion and be the debrief scribe? Also need a quick clarification on the rubric: do we score system-design on a 1–5 scale or use the yes/no checklist? I’ll need to update the calendar + GH invite once swapped.

samir: I can take the technical portion, but I only have 3:00–3:30 free (I have a hard 3:30 meeting). Is the tech segment flexible?

jordan: Sorry all — family emergency, appreciate the cover. Priya, the packet + eval link is here: <https://playbook.internal/interviews/evals> (last updated last week). Use the SWE2 template.

elena: I can scribe. Quick rubric note: we use 1–5 numeric for competencies and a short yes/no for "meets bar" at the bottom. Numeric = 1 (doesn't meet), 3 (meets), 5 (exceeds). For system design, capture "approach, tradeoffs, API/infra notes" in the comments field.

samir: OK I can do 3:00–3:30 for deep tech Qs then leave behavior to someone else? If we need 45m for tech I can't extend.

priya: Thanks — plan: samir covers tech 3:00–3:30, elena scribe + handle brief behavioral follow-ups, jordan pls send any handoff notes (sample prompts). I'll move the calendar to block 3:00–3:30 tech, 3:30–3:45 quick behavioral + debrief.

elena: Got it. I'll open the eval in the meeting and take notes in the "eval comments" section. Small ask: when scoring, add 1–2 bullet examples for any 1 or 2 scores so hiring panel has evidence.

hiring-bot: Reminder scheduled: Interview (SWE2) — Thu 2026-03-19 15:00 PT. Invite updated: room "Zoom - Eng Interviews".

priya: Perfect — can everyone react with :thumbsup: if this plan works so I can update Greenhouse? If anyone needs a different timeslot speak up now.

samir: :thumbsup:

elena: :thumbsup:

jordan: thanks all, :thumbsup: and will DM handoff notes to @priya

priya: Thank you! I'll update GH + calendar and post the final eval link here before the interview."
